reason: This case's captures were generated after its case.json description leak was fixed on disk, but before that fix (4c8994a) was committed to this repository's git history -- an ordinary build-then-commit workflow, not a structural defect, but the coordinating reviewer's requirement is that the corrected prompt content itself be committed strictly before generation. Withdrawn and replaced with a fresh capture generated after the protocol-freeze commit that added benchmarks/agent_quality/protocol_registry.json and bumped this case's case.json to version 2.

discovered_by.method: Chronology audit comparing each capture's capture_ingested_at_utc against the git committer date of the commit that first established or corrected its prompt-package content.
